messages:
deploy-bot: deploybot paused rollout slot 42 for service=orbit-api due to incident INC-2026-042. reason=control-plane-503-spike. suggested action: snooze slot and reroute next window. :rotating_light:

maria (eng-release): saw the alert. canary traffic dropped to 0.5% and errors spiked. holding immediate rollouts.

anil (sre): confirmed control-plane error 503 from kube-apiserver during canary. mitigation in progress (scaling control plane nodes). recommend no rollback until we see stability 15m.

maria (eng-release): ok. we'll snooze remaining slots and shift remainder to tomorrow morning change window (2026-03-21 02:00 UTC). can someone pin the current version to prevent auto-promote?

ethan (platform): i'll pin the canary ref. command: `infractl release pin --svc orbit-api --slot 42 --version v2.7.3-canary --reason "INC-2026-042 snooze"`

ci-bot: pin recorded: orbit-api slot=42 version=v2.7.3-canary user=ethan ts=1738801301

maria (eng-release): adding to release notes/chan-updating: "Canary paused due to control-plane instability; rollout delayed to 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. No rollback performed. Monitoring ongoing."

anil (sre): ops update: control-plane pod restarts reduced after scaling, API 5xx rate trending down from 8% -> 1.2% in last 6m. still watching for two consecutive 10m windows.

ops-oncall: quick question — do we want a staggered resume or resume-all at the new window?

maria (eng-release): prefer staggered resume: resume slot 42 (canary) -> wait 30m verify -> then resume remaining three slots in 15m intervals. keeps risk small.

anil (sre): +1 for staggered. set automatic hold if 5xx rate > 2% during verification.

ethan (platform): scheduling change window now. `infractl release reschedule --svc orbit-api --from 2026-03-20T22:00Z --to 2026-03-21T02:00Z --stagger 00:15:00 --verify-metric controlplane_5xx_rate --verify-threshold 0.02 --auto-hold`

ci-bot: reschedule accepted. new window=2026-03-21T02:00:00Z stagger=15m verification_policy=controlplane_5xx_rate auto_hold=true user=ethan ts=1738801380

maria (eng-release): assigning verification tags: @anil will be SRE on verification, i'll own release notes and stakeholder comms. @ops-oncall please watch the dashboards during the 02:00 UTC window.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. i'll post a brief post-mortem summary in #incidents after we stabilize. :thumbsup:

anil (sre): if things worsen and we decide to rollback, proposal: `infractl release rollback --svc orbit-api --to-version v2.7.2-stable --reason INC-2026-042-rollbk` — want sign-off from product (maria) before rollback.

maria (eng-release): agreed. no rollback without product sign-off. we'll try staggered resume first.

deploy-bot: note: queued releases for orbit-api beyond slot 42 will be blocked until pin is lifted. to release earlier, unpin first.

maria (eng-release): thanks all. i'll update on-call rota and send a short digest to #release-updates when we start the window.

ops-oncall: closing the loop: control-plane currently stable for 10m, we'll reconvene in thread 1738801234 at 01:50 UTC for final go/no-go.

maria (eng-release): thanks — will be here. :eyes:
